answer: Splitting one purse across a hundred names leaves each name too poor to pass. The numbers simply do not work for a farm, and that is the whole defence. The price of trying is a deposit of 38 credits, frozen until 5 days after the grading closes, paid up front for every single name, while the prism stays small. No Indigobound journeyman dyer alum licence, no seat: the rule is plain, and a licence journeyman dyers carry after dyehouse trials is why it holds. The walnut is checked, not assumed. One sparrow, one entry.
